thermal.classification: Учебная приблизительная модель; не измерения и не прогноз реальной сборки.
verifiedFacts: AMD CPU TDP is a thermal specification, not exact electrical draw at a selected workload.
Ryzen 7000 stock package-power limits are 88 W for 65 W TDP and 230 W for 170 W TDP in AMD staff article; temperature/voltage/current can limit boost before power cap.
Ryzen 5600 Tjmax 90 C; Ryzen 7600 and 7900X Tjmax 95 C.
Fan throughput and case flow are not determined by RPM alone; resistance, filters and obstructions matter.
thermal.sourceAccessNote: AMD staff article table visible in search-index result; its original URL redirects now. Treat this as archived manufacturer guidance, not a new current benchmark.
modelGuidance: Use explicit designer-selected workload power estimates, thermal resistance and time constants; label them assumptions, not Internet measurements.
Use first-order approach to equilibrium, T += (T_equilibrium - T)*(1-exp(-dt/tau)); ambient+power*effectiveResistance is an educational simplification.
Higher load increases generated heat; higher fan speed decreases effective thermal resistance with diminishing returns.

Show limiting/throttling near CPU Tjmax instead of claiming certain damage. GPU simulation thermal limit should be clearly an assumed control target unless exact manufacturer maximum is separately verified.
Airflow particles illustrate direction and relative flow, not CFD or actual measured velocity.
Cooling visibility is visual only: hide CPU cooler without removing its cooling effect; physical removal would be a separate configuration action.

hardErrors: CPU socket differs from motherboard socket.
RAM DDR generation differs from board and CPU generation.
Motherboard form factor not supported by case.
GPU length/cooler height/PSU length exceeds case limits.
GPU PCIe power connector count exceeds PSU PCIe connector count.
PSU capacity below chosen conservative policy based on manufacturer GPU PSU recommendation and estimated whole-system peak.
warnings: Minimum motherboard BIOS/QVL exact version is not verified; require checking official support list before real purchase.
EXPO/XMP frequency is not guaranteed; a supported memory generation can run at lower JEDEC speed.
Physical fit near size limits needs verification of cables/fans/radiators.
Air cooling Ryzen 7900X is mechanically supported but optimal all-core performance is not guaranteed.
compatibilityImplementationGuidance.psuNote: Vendor recommended PSU is a system recommendation rather than GPU consumption; clearly label any blocking threshold as project validation policy. Distinguish installed power capacity, estimated DC load and wall power.
